comment: The ID token carries `tid`, the tenant's id. One rIDM deployment issues for many tenants, so a relying party serving several of them keys on it; the issuer only names the tenant's slug. Documented in the README under Token claims.

rIDM does not implement the `claims` request parameter (OIDC Core 5.5) and says so in discovery with `claims_parameter_supported: false`, so a claim asked for that way is not returned. The scopes cover the same claims.
